'GeometricTraceR04.integrated_preserves' depends on axioms: [propext, Classical.choice, Quot.sound]
'GeometricTraceR04.integrated_projection_order' depends on axioms: [propext, Classical.choice, Quot.sound]
'GeometricTraceR04.integrated_projection_order' depends on axioms: [propext, Classical.choice, Quot.sound]
GeometricTraceR04.integrated_projection_order.{u_1, u_2} {G : Type u_1} {H : Type u_2} [MeasurableSpace G]
  [NormedAddCommGroup H] [InnerProductSpace ℂ H] [CompleteSpace H] (μ : Measure G) (V : Submodule ℂ H)
  [V.HasOrthogonalProjection] (R : G → H →L[ℂ] H) (hR : ∀ (g : G), ∀ v ∈ V, (R g) v ∈ V) (h : G → ℂ) (A : H →L[ℂ] H)
  (hint : ∀ (v : H), Integrable (fun g => h g • (R g) v) μ) (hA : ∀ (v : H), A v = ∫ (g : G), h g • (R g) v ∂μ) :
  (ContinuousLinearMap.id ℂ H - V.starProjection).comp A =
    ((ContinuousLinearMap.id ℂ H - V.starProjection).comp A).comp (ContinuousLinearMap.id ℂ H - V.starProjection)
